statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93229
The denial reason code is CO-197
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The note states that continuous monitoring is required to assess arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation therapy
The denial is based on medical necessity grounds
